basic_info.description: This remarkable 4-level Victorian residence offers a rare opportunity to live directly across from Alta Plaza Park, close to Fillmore Street's shops and cafes. Fully detached, the home is bathed in natural light and showcases exquisite period details soaring ceilings, ornate moldings, and multiple fireplaces seamlessly blended with modern updates for today's lifestyle.  A gracious foyer welcomes you, and, to the left, a grand double parlor overlooks the park and flows effortlessly into the formal dining room. Next, the family room adjoins a spacious eat-in kitchen with direct access to a deck and stairs to the private garden. Powder room also on this level.  The 2nd-floor has 4 bedrooms, including the primary suite with sweeping views of the park and downtown skyline, a walk-in closet, and a classically updated bath. 3 additional bedrooms share a charming renovated hall bath.  The top level offers versatility with another bedroom, an office or two, a full bath, and a bright open space--perfect as an artist's studio or home gym.   The lower level has a generous pantry/storage room, laundry room, full bath, rec room, and interior access to the two-car SxS garage.   This home is truly one-of-a-kind, rarely available, impeccably designed, and ideally located. Walk Score: 96
